settings.prompt: This is a scanned archival page. List its blocks of text (each paragraph, heading, list, table, caption, handwritten note or marginal annotation, plus running headers, footers and page numbers) in the order a person would read the page. Give one box per block; a box never spans two columns. Return JSON only, first block read first: {"blocks": [{"label": one of ["heading", "paragraph", "list", "table", "caption", "handwriting", "marginalia", "header", "footer", "page_number", "figure"], "box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] on a 0-1000 scale of the image}]}. No transcription.

lines.l9: Vision lines inside DocLayout-YOLO body regions (W46.layout-order's L9 set)
lines.owner: Vision lines at the app's settings (W46.layout-order-marks's set)
